name: stand-up
example: Let's keep the stand-up under fifteen minutes and take details offline.
exampleTrans: 我们把站会控制在十五分钟内，细节会后再聊。

name: sprint
trans: n. 冲刺（一个迭代周期）
example: We have three tickets left to finish before the end of this sprint.
exampleTrans: 这个冲刺结束前我们还有三个工单要完成。

name: deadline
example: The deadline for the payment migration has been moved to next Friday.
exampleTrans: 支付迁移的截止日期推迟到了下周五。

name: estimate
example: Can you give me a rough estimate for the search feature by tomorrow?
exampleTrans: 你明天之前能给我一个搜索功能的大致估算吗？

name: blocker
example: My only blocker right now is waiting for access to the staging database.
exampleTrans: 我现在唯一的卡点是在等预发布数据库的访问权限。

name: priority
example: Fixing the login bug is our top priority for this week.
exampleTrans: 修复登录 bug 是我们本周的最高优先级。

name: prioritize
trans: v. 确定优先级；优先处理
example: We need to prioritize the checkout issues over the UI polish.
exampleTrans: 我们需要优先处理结账问题，而不是界面打磨。

name: ticket
example: Please create a ticket for this bug so we can track it.
exampleTrans: 请为这个 bug 建一个工单，方便我们跟踪。

name: backlog
trans: n. 待办列表；积压任务
example: Let's move the dark mode request to the backlog for now.
exampleTrans: 我们先把深色模式的需求放进待办列表。

name: requirement
example: The product team updated the requirements, so we need to adjust the design.
exampleTrans: 产品团队更新了需求，所以我们得调整设计。

name: scope
example: Let's narrow the scope so we can ship something useful this sprint.
exampleTrans: 我们缩小一下范围，这样本次冲刺就能交付有用的东西。

name: out of scope
example: Mobile support is out of scope for the first release.
exampleTrans: 移动端支持不在第一个版本的范围内。

name: ship
example: We plan to ship the new onboarding flow by the end of the month.
exampleTrans: 我们计划在月底前上线新的引导流程。

name: release
example: The next release will include the new search filters and several bug fixes.
exampleTrans: 下个版本将包含新的搜索筛选和若干 bug 修复。

name: code review
example: I left a few comments in the code review about error handling.
exampleTrans: 我在代码评审里留了几条关于错误处理的意见。

name: pull request
example: I've opened a pull request; could you take a look when you have time?
exampleTrans: 我提了一个拉取请求，你有空的时候能看一下吗？

name: reviewer
example: I added you as a reviewer because you know the billing code best.
exampleTrans: 我把你加为评审人，因为你最熟悉计费代码。

name: approve
example: Once two people approve the change, you can merge it into main.
exampleTrans: 有两个人通过评审后，你就可以合并到主分支。

name: feedback
example: Thanks for the feedback; I'll update the naming and push again.
exampleTrans: 谢谢反馈，我改一下命名再重新推送。

name: sync
example: Let's sync after lunch to go over the rollout plan together.
exampleTrans: 午饭后我们对一下，一起过一遍发布计划。

name: follow up
example: I'll follow up with the security team about the certificate issue.
exampleTrans: 我会跟安全团队跟进证书的问题。

name: heads-up
example: Just a heads-up: the staging server will be down for maintenance tonight.
exampleTrans: 提前说一下：预发布服务器今晚会停机维护。

name: ETA
example: What's the ETA on the fix for the broken export button?
exampleTrans: 导出按钮的修复预计什么时候能好？

name: milestone
example: Finishing the data migration is the biggest milestone for this quarter.
exampleTrans: 完成数据迁移是本季度最大的里程碑。

name: roadmap
example: Offline mode is on the roadmap, but not until next year.
exampleTrans: 离线模式在路线图上，但要到明年才做。

name: stakeholder
example: We should demo the prototype to stakeholders before committing to the design.
exampleTrans: 在确定设计之前，我们应该先给相关方演示原型。

name: retrospective
example: In the retrospective, we agreed to write smaller pull requests.
exampleTrans: 在回顾会上，我们一致同意以后提更小的 PR。

name: action item
example: My action item from the meeting is to update the API documentation.
exampleTrans: 我会后的行动项是更新 API 文档。

name: bandwidth
example: I don't have the bandwidth to take on another feature this sprint.
exampleTrans: 这个冲刺我没有余力再接一个功能了。

name: ownership
example: She took ownership of the flaky test problem and fixed it in a day.
exampleTrans: 她主动负责了不稳定测试的问题，一天就解决了。

name: handoff
example: Let's schedule a handoff meeting before you go on vacation next week.
exampleTrans: 你下周休假前我们安排一次交接会议吧。

name: onboarding
trans: n. 新人入职；上手引导
example: Good documentation makes onboarding much faster for new engineers.
exampleTrans: 好的文档能让新工程师上手快得多。

name: user story
example: Each user story should describe who needs the feature and why.
exampleTrans: 每个用户故事都应说明谁需要这个功能以及原因。

name: acceptance criteria
example: The ticket is not done until it meets all the acceptance criteria.
exampleTrans: 工单要满足所有验收标准才算完成。

name: velocity
example: Our velocity dropped this sprint because two people were on leave.
exampleTrans: 这个冲刺我们的速率下降了，因为有两个人请假。

name: agile
example: Our team follows an agile process with two-week sprints.
exampleTrans: 我们团队采用两周一个冲刺的敏捷流程。

name: iteration
example: The first iteration is rough, but we'll improve it based on feedback.
exampleTrans: 第一版迭代比较粗糙，我们会根据反馈改进。

name: alignment
example: We need alignment with the backend team before changing the API contract.
exampleTrans: 修改 API 约定之前，我们需要先和后端团队达成一致。

name: align
example: Let's align on the naming before we write any more code.
exampleTrans: 在继续写代码之前，我们先统一一下命名。

name: escalate
example: If the vendor doesn't respond by noon, please escalate it to your manager.
exampleTrans: 如果供应商中午前还不回复，请上报给你的经理。

name: loop in
example: Let me loop in Sarah, since she wrote the original caching logic.
exampleTrans: 我把 Sarah 拉进来，原来的缓存逻辑是她写的。

name: ping
example: Feel free to ping me on Slack if the build fails again.
exampleTrans: 如果构建再失败，随时在 Slack 上找我。

name: circle back
example: Let's circle back on the database choice after we finish the benchmark.
exampleTrans: 等基准测试做完，我们再回头讨论数据库选型。

name: walk through
example: Could you walk me through how the retry logic works?
exampleTrans: 你能给我讲一下重试逻辑是怎么运作的吗？

name: ramp up
trans: v. 熟悉上手；逐步增加
example: It took me about two weeks to ramp up on the payments codebase.
exampleTrans: 我花了大约两周才熟悉支付相关的代码库。

name: sign off
example: We need the product manager to sign off on the design before we start.
exampleTrans: 开工前我们需要产品经理确认设计。

name: scope creep
example: Adding export features now would be scope creep, so let's defer them.
exampleTrans: 现在加导出功能会造成需求蔓延，先推后吧。

name: low-hanging fruit
example: Let's start with the low-hanging fruit, like enabling gzip compression.
exampleTrans: 我们先从容易的改进入手，比如开启 gzip 压缩。

name: on-call
example: I'm on-call this weekend, so I'll keep my laptop nearby.
exampleTrans: 我这个周末值班，所以会把电脑放在身边。

name: incident
example: We opened an incident when error rates spiked after the deploy.
exampleTrans: 部署后错误率飙升，我们开了一个故障事件。

name: outage
example: The outage lasted twenty minutes and affected users in Europe.
exampleTrans: 这次宕机持续了二十分钟，影响了欧洲的用户。

name: postmortem
example: We'll write a blameless postmortem to understand what went wrong.
exampleTrans: 我们会写一份不追责的复盘报告，弄清楚哪里出了问题。

name: workaround
example: As a workaround, users can clear their cache and log in again.
exampleTrans: 作为临时办法，用户可以清除缓存后重新登录。

name: edge case
example: Did you handle the edge case where the list is empty?
exampleTrans: 你处理了列表为空的边界情况吗？

name: trade-off
example: Caching improves speed, but the trade-off is slightly stale data.
exampleTrans: 缓存提升了速度，代价是数据可能略有延迟。

name: demo
example: I'll demo the new dashboard at the end of the sprint review.
exampleTrans: 我会在冲刺评审最后演示新的仪表盘。

name: spec
trans: n. 规格说明；需求文档
example: The spec says the endpoint should return results sorted by date.
exampleTrans: 规格说明里写着这个接口应按日期排序返回结果。

name: proof of concept
example: I built a quick proof of concept to see if the library fits our needs.
exampleTrans: 我做了一个快速的概念验证，看这个库是否满足需求。

name: MVP
example: For the MVP, we'll skip user roles and only support admins.
exampleTrans: MVP 阶段我们先不做用户角色，只支持管理员。

name: tech lead
example: Check with the tech lead before introducing a new dependency.
exampleTrans: 引入新依赖前先和技术负责人确认一下。

name: use case
example: What's the main use case for this endpoint?
exampleTrans: 这个接口的主要使用场景是什么？

name: nitpick
example: Just a nitpick: this variable name could be a bit clearer.
exampleTrans: 只是个小意见：这个变量名可以再清楚一点。

name: LGTM
trans: phr. 看起来没问题（评审用语）
example: LGTM, but please add a test for the timeout case before merging.
exampleTrans: 看起来没问题，不过合并前请为超时情况补一个测试。

name: refactor
example: Let's refactor this module before adding new features.
exampleTrans: 在添加新功能之前，我们先重构这个模块。

name: dependency
example: We should remove this dependency because it's no longer maintained.
exampleTrans: 我们应该移除这个依赖，因为它已经没人维护了。

name: interface
example: Both payment providers implement the same interface, so we can swap them easily.
exampleTrans: 两个支付提供方实现了同一个接口，所以可以轻松替换。

name: implement
example: I'll implement the validation logic and open a pull request this afternoon.
exampleTrans: 我今天下午实现校验逻辑并提交 PR。

name: implementation
example: The current implementation loads everything into memory at once.
exampleTrans: 当前的实现会一次性把所有数据加载进内存。

name: latency
example: Moving the database closer to users cut our latency in half.
exampleTrans: 把数据库部署得离用户更近，让延迟减少了一半。

name: throughput
example: Batching the writes greatly increased throughput on the ingestion service.
exampleTrans: 批量写入大幅提升了数据接入服务的吞吐量。

name: performance
example: This change should improve performance on pages with long tables.
exampleTrans: 这次改动应该能提升长表格页面的性能。

name: scalability
example: We chose this design mainly for scalability as traffic keeps growing.
exampleTrans: 随着流量持续增长，我们选择这个设计主要是为了可扩展性。

name: scalable
example: We need a more scalable way to store user events.
exampleTrans: 我们需要一种更可扩展的方式来存储用户事件。

name: bottleneck
example: Profiling showed that the database query is the real bottleneck.
exampleTrans: 性能分析显示，真正的瓶颈是数据库查询。

name: architecture
example: The new architecture separates reading and writing into different services.
exampleTrans: 新架构把读和写拆分到不同的服务中。

name: codebase
example: The codebase is large, so start by reading the core modules.
exampleTrans: 代码库很大，先从核心模块读起吧。

name: technical debt
example: We need to pay down some technical debt before the next big feature.
exampleTrans: 在下一个大功能之前，我们得先还一些技术债。

name: legacy code
example: Be careful when touching legacy code that has no tests.
exampleTrans: 改动没有测试的遗留代码时要小心。

name: module
example: The auth module handles login, logout and session refresh.
exampleTrans: 认证模块负责登录、登出和会话刷新。

name: component
example: I extracted the date picker into a reusable component.
exampleTrans: 我把日期选择器抽成了一个可复用的组件。

name: API
example: The mobile app talks to our backend through a REST API.
exampleTrans: 移动应用通过 REST API 与我们的后端通信。

name: endpoint
example: This endpoint returns a list of orders for the current user.
exampleTrans: 这个接口返回当前用户的订单列表。

name: payload
example: The request payload is too large, so the server rejects it.
exampleTrans: 请求体太大，所以服务器拒绝了它。

name: schema
example: We need to update the database schema to add a status column.
exampleTrans: 我们需要更新数据库表结构，加一个状态字段。

name: query
example: This query scans the whole table, so it gets slower as data grows.
exampleTrans: 这条查询会扫全表，所以数据越多越慢。

name: index
example: Adding an index on the email column made the lookup much faster.
exampleTrans: 给邮箱字段加了索引后，查找快了很多。

name: cache
example: We cache the product list for five minutes to reduce database load.
exampleTrans: 我们把商品列表缓存五分钟，以降低数据库压力。

name: configuration
example: Move these values out of the code and into the configuration file.
exampleTrans: 把这些值从代码里移到配置文件中。

name: environment variable
example: Store the API key in an environment variable, not in the repo.
exampleTrans: 把 API 密钥放在环境变量里，不要放进代码仓库。

name: feature flag
example: The new checkout is behind a feature flag until testing is done.
exampleTrans: 新的结账流程在测试完成前一直由功能开关控制。

name: breaking change
example: Renaming this field is a breaking change for our API clients.
exampleTrans: 重命名这个字段对 API 调用方来说是破坏性变更。

name: backward compatible
example: Make sure the new version is backward compatible with old config files.
exampleTrans: 确保新版本能向后兼容旧的配置文件。

name: hardcode
example: Please don't hardcode the server URL; read it from config instead.
exampleTrans: 请不要把服务器地址写死，改为从配置读取。

name: boilerplate
example: This generator removes a lot of boilerplate when creating new services.
exampleTrans: 这个生成器在创建新服务时省去了大量样板代码。

name: abstraction
example: This abstraction hides the differences between the two storage providers.
exampleTrans: 这层抽象屏蔽了两个存储服务之间的差异。

name: coupling
example: Tight coupling between these modules makes testing really difficult.
exampleTrans: 这些模块之间耦合太紧，导致测试非常困难。

name: decouple
example: We used a message queue to decouple the order service from email sending.
exampleTrans: 我们用消息队列把订单服务和发邮件解耦。

name: encapsulation
example: Good encapsulation means other classes can't change this state directly.
exampleTrans: 良好的封装意味着其他类不能直接修改这个状态。

name: microservice
example: Each microservice owns its own database and deploys independently.
exampleTrans: 每个微服务都有自己的数据库，并且独立部署。

name: monolith
example: We're slowly breaking the monolith into smaller services.
exampleTrans: 我们正在逐步把单体应用拆成更小的服务。

name: framework
example: Which framework are you using for the frontend?
exampleTrans: 前端你用的是哪个框架？

name: library
example: Instead of writing our own parser, let's use a well-tested library.
exampleTrans: 与其自己写解析器，不如用一个经过充分测试的库。

name: middleware
example: We added middleware that logs every incoming request.
exampleTrans: 我们加了一个中间件，记录每个进来的请求。

name: asynchronous
example: Image processing is asynchronous, so the API returns before it finishes.
exampleTrans: 图片处理是异步的，所以接口会在处理完成前就返回。

name: synchronous
example: A synchronous call here would block the main thread for seconds.
exampleTrans: 这里用同步调用会让主线程阻塞好几秒。

name: async
trans: adj. 异步的（含异步沟通）
example: Our team works across time zones, so most communication is async.
exampleTrans: 我们团队跨时区工作，所以大部分沟通是异步的。

name: concurrency
example: Increasing concurrency helped, but it also raised memory usage.
exampleTrans: 提高并发数有帮助，但也增加了内存占用。

name: race condition
example: The duplicate orders were caused by a race condition in the payment handler.
exampleTrans: 重复订单是由支付处理器中的竞态条件导致的。

name: deadlock
example: Two transactions waiting on each other caused a deadlock in production.
exampleTrans: 两个事务相互等待，在生产环境造成了死锁。

name: callback
example: The callback runs after the file has finished uploading.
exampleTrans: 回调会在文件上传完成后执行。

name: parameter
example: This function takes an optional parameter for the page size.
exampleTrans: 这个函数接受一个可选的分页大小参数。

name: instance
example: We run three instances of the service behind the load balancer.
exampleTrans: 我们在负载均衡器后面运行了这个服务的三个实例。

name: exception
example: The parser throws an exception when the input is not valid JSON.
exampleTrans: 输入不是合法 JSON 时，解析器会抛出异常。

name: serialize
example: We serialize the object to JSON before saving it to the cache.
exampleTrans: 我们在存入缓存前先把对象序列化成 JSON。

name: authentication
example: All internal endpoints now require authentication with a valid token.
exampleTrans: 所有内部接口现在都要求使用有效令牌进行身份认证。

name: authorization
example: Authentication passed, but authorization failed because the user lacks admin rights.
exampleTrans: 身份认证通过了，但授权失败，因为用户没有管理员权限。

name: token
example: The access token expires after one hour, so we refresh it automatically.
exampleTrans: 访问令牌一小时后过期，所以我们会自动刷新。

name: encryption
example: All personal data must be stored with encryption at rest.
exampleTrans: 所有个人数据必须加密存储。

name: vulnerability
example: The scanner found a known vulnerability in an old version of the library.
exampleTrans: 扫描工具在这个库的旧版本中发现了一个已知漏洞。

name: rate limit
example: The third-party API has a rate limit of one hundred requests per minute.
exampleTrans: 第三方 API 的限流是每分钟一百次请求。

name: load balancer
example: The load balancer sends traffic only to healthy instances.
exampleTrans: 负载均衡器只把流量转发给健康的实例。

name: timeout
example: Set a timeout on external calls so one slow service can't hang everything.
exampleTrans: 给外部调用设置超时，避免一个慢服务拖垮所有东西。

name: retry
example: The client will retry failed requests up to three times.
exampleTrans: 客户端会对失败请求最多重试三次。

name: fallback
example: If the recommendation service is down, we show popular items as a fallback.
exampleTrans: 如果推荐服务挂了，我们就展示热门商品作为兜底。

name: high availability
example: We run the database in two regions for high availability.
exampleTrans: 为了高可用，我们在两个区域部署了数据库。

name: distributed system
example: Debugging a distributed system is hard because logs are spread across services.
exampleTrans: 调试分布式系统很难，因为日志分散在各个服务中。

name: message queue
example: Orders are put on a message queue and processed by background workers.
exampleTrans: 订单会放入消息队列，由后台任务处理。

name: stateless
example: Keep the API servers stateless so we can scale them horizontally.
exampleTrans: 保持 API 服务器无状态，这样就能水平扩容。

name: migration
trans: n. 迁移（数据库或系统）
example: Run the migration on staging first to make sure nothing breaks.
exampleTrans: 先在预发布环境运行迁移，确保没有问题。

name: transaction
example: Wrap both updates in a single transaction so they succeed or fail together.
exampleTrans: 把两次更新放在一个事务里，要么都成功要么都失败。

name: consistency
example: We trade some consistency for speed by reading from replicas.
exampleTrans: 我们从副本读取数据，用部分一致性换取速度。

name: pagination
example: Add pagination to this endpoint so it doesn't return thousands of rows.
exampleTrans: 给这个接口加上分页，免得一次返回上千行。

name: webhook
example: The payment provider calls our webhook when a charge succeeds.
exampleTrans: 扣款成功时，支付服务商会调用我们的回调接口。

name: frontend
example: The frontend validates the form, but the server must check it too.
exampleTrans: 前端会校验表单，但服务端也必须再检查一遍。

name: backend
example: The backend team is adding a new field to the user profile API.
exampleTrans: 后端团队正在给用户资料接口加一个新字段。

name: tech stack
example: Our tech stack is TypeScript on the frontend and Java on the backend.
exampleTrans: 我们的技术栈是前端 TypeScript、后端 Java。

name: open source
example: We rely on several open source libraries, so check their licenses.
exampleTrans: 我们依赖好几个开源库，所以要检查它们的许可证。

name: third-party
example: Wrap third-party calls so we can replace the vendor later.
exampleTrans: 把第三方调用封装起来，以后才方便更换供应商。

name: repository
example: All of our infrastructure code lives in a separate repository.
exampleTrans: 我们所有的基础设施代码都放在单独的仓库里。

name: branch
example: Create a new branch for each feature instead of working on main.
exampleTrans: 每个功能都新建一个分支，不要直接在主分支上开发。

name: merge
example: I'll merge your changes once the tests pass.
exampleTrans: 测试通过后我就合并你的改动。

name: merge conflict
example: I had to resolve a merge conflict in the routing file.
exampleTrans: 我得解决路由文件里的一个合并冲突。

name: commit
example: Please write clear commit messages that explain why the change was made.
exampleTrans: 请写清楚提交说明，解释为什么做这个改动。

name: rebase
example: Please rebase your branch on the latest main before I review it.
exampleTrans: 在我评审之前，请把你的分支变基到最新的主分支上。

name: cherry-pick
example: Can you cherry-pick that fix into the release branch?
exampleTrans: 你能把那个修复挑选合入到发布分支吗？

name: revert
example: The change broke the login page, so I reverted it immediately.
exampleTrans: 这个改动搞坏了登录页，所以我立刻回退了。

name: diff
example: The diff is huge because the formatter touched every file.
exampleTrans: 改动对比非常大，因为格式化工具改了每个文件。

name: version control
example: Everything, including config files, should be under version control.
exampleTrans: 所有东西，包括配置文件，都应纳入版本控制。

name: deploy
example: We usually deploy to production twice a week.
exampleTrans: 我们通常每周部署两次到生产环境。

name: deployment
example: The deployment failed because a required secret was missing.
exampleTrans: 部署失败了，因为缺少一个必需的密钥。

name: rollback
example: If error rates go up, we'll do a rollback to the previous version.
exampleTrans: 如果错误率上升，我们就回滚到上一个版本。

name: roll out
example: We'll roll out the feature to ten percent of users first.
exampleTrans: 我们会先把这个功能发布给百分之十的用户。

name: hotfix
example: We shipped a hotfix within an hour of the bug report.
exampleTrans: 收到 bug 报告后一小时内我们就上线了紧急修复。

name: patch
example: The vendor released a security patch, so we need to upgrade today.
exampleTrans: 供应商发布了安全补丁，我们今天需要升级。

name: build
example: The build is broken on main; who merged last?
exampleTrans: 主分支的构建挂了，最后是谁合并的？

name: pipeline
example: The pipeline runs linting, tests and a security scan on every push.
exampleTrans: 每次推送，流水线都会运行代码检查、测试和安全扫描。

name: continuous integration
example: Continuous integration catches broken tests before code reaches main.
exampleTrans: 持续集成能在代码进入主分支前发现失败的测试。

name: staging
example: Please test the fix on staging before we deploy to production.
exampleTrans: 部署到生产前，请先在预发布环境测试修复。

name: production
example: Never run untested migration scripts directly against the production database.
exampleTrans: 绝不要直接在生产数据库上运行未经测试的迁移脚本。

name: environment
example: The bug only shows up in the test environment, not locally.
exampleTrans: 这个 bug 只在测试环境出现，本地没有。

name: container
example: Each service runs in its own container with a fixed memory limit.
exampleTrans: 每个服务都运行在独立的容器中，内存有固定上限。

name: infrastructure
example: The infrastructure team manages our servers, networks and databases.
exampleTrans: 基础设施团队负责管理我们的服务器、网络和数据库。

name: spin up
example: Let's spin up a temporary environment to test this branch.
exampleTrans: 我们启动一个临时环境来测试这个分支。

name: monitoring
example: Our monitoring didn't catch the issue because the alert threshold was too high.
exampleTrans: 我们的监控没发现问题，因为告警阈值设得太高了。

name: alert
example: I got an alert at 3 a.m. about high CPU usage.
exampleTrans: 我凌晨三点收到一条 CPU 使用率过高的告警。

name: dashboard
example: Check the dashboard to see if latency went up after the release.
exampleTrans: 看看仪表盘，确认发布后延迟有没有上升。

name: log
example: Check the logs around the time the request failed.
exampleTrans: 查看请求失败那个时间点前后的日志。

name: logging
example: Add more logging to the payment flow so we can trace failures.
exampleTrans: 在支付流程里多加些日志，方便追踪失败原因。

name: metrics
example: We track metrics like error rate, latency and active users.
exampleTrans: 我们跟踪错误率、延迟和活跃用户等指标。

name: observability
example: Better observability would have helped us find the root cause faster.
exampleTrans: 如果可观测性更好，我们能更快找到根本原因。

name: downtime
example: The migration can be done without any downtime for users.
exampleTrans: 这次迁移可以在用户无感知停机的情况下完成。

name: SLA
example: Our SLA promises a response to critical incidents within fifteen minutes.
exampleTrans: 我们的服务等级协议承诺十五分钟内响应严重故障。

name: dependency injection
example: Dependency injection makes it easy to replace the database with a mock in tests.
exampleTrans: 依赖注入让测试时用模拟对象替换数据库变得很容易。

name: runtime
example: This error only appears at runtime, so the compiler won't catch it.
exampleTrans: 这个错误只在运行时出现，编译器发现不了。

name: linter
example: The linter flagged an unused variable in your last commit.
exampleTrans: 代码检查工具在你上次提交中发现了一个未使用的变量。

name: release notes
example: Please add a line about the new export option to the release notes.
exampleTrans: 请在发布说明里加一行关于新导出选项的介绍。

name: changelog
example: Check the changelog before upgrading to see what might break.
exampleTrans: 升级前先看看变更日志，了解哪些地方可能不兼容。

name: semantic versioning
example: We follow semantic versioning, so breaking changes bump the major version.
exampleTrans: 我们遵循语义化版本，破坏性变更会提升主版本号。

name: upgrade
example: We need to upgrade the framework before its support ends next year.
exampleTrans: 在框架明年停止支持之前，我们需要升级它。

name: bump
example: I bumped the library version to pick up the security fix.
exampleTrans: 我提升了库的版本号，以获取安全修复。

name: documentation
example: The documentation is out of date, so I'll update it after this change.
exampleTrans: 文档已经过时了，这次改完后我来更新。

name: bug
example: I found a bug where the total price ignores the discount.
exampleTrans: 我发现一个 bug：总价没有算上折扣。

name: debug
example: I spent the morning trying to debug a memory issue in the worker.
exampleTrans: 我花了一上午调试后台任务里的内存问题。

name: stack trace
example: Can you paste the full stack trace into the ticket?
exampleTrans: 你能把完整的堆栈信息贴到工单里吗？

name: regression
example: This is a regression; the feature worked fine in the last release.
exampleTrans: 这是个回归问题，上个版本里这个功能还是好的。

name: reproduce
example: I can't reproduce the issue on my machine; can you share the steps?
exampleTrans: 我在自己电脑上复现不了，你能分享一下步骤吗？

name: repro
example: Do you have a minimal repro for the crash?
exampleTrans: 这个崩溃你有最小复现示例吗？

name: root cause
example: The root cause was a missing index on the orders table.
exampleTrans: 根本原因是订单表缺少索引。

name: troubleshoot
example: I'm still troubleshooting why the emails aren't being sent.
exampleTrans: 我还在排查为什么邮件没有发出去。

name: breakpoint
example: Set a breakpoint inside the loop and inspect the variables.
exampleTrans: 在循环里设一个断点，然后检查变量。

name: crash
example: The app crashes whenever a user uploads a file larger than 10 MB.
exampleTrans: 只要用户上传超过 10MB 的文件，应用就会崩溃。

name: memory leak
example: Memory usage keeps growing, so we probably have a memory leak.
exampleTrans: 内存占用一直在涨，我们可能有内存泄漏。

name: flaky
trans: adj. 不稳定的（时好时坏）
example: This test is flaky; it fails about once every ten runs.
exampleTrans: 这个测试不稳定，大概每跑十次失败一次。

name: intermittent
example: Users are reporting intermittent errors when saving their profile.
exampleTrans: 用户反馈保存资料时会间歇性报错。

name: error message
example: The error message should tell users what went wrong and how to fix it.
exampleTrans: 错误信息应该告诉用户出了什么问题以及如何解决。

name: warning
example: Please fix the compiler warnings before merging this branch.
exampleTrans: 合并这个分支前，请先修复编译器警告。

name: side effect
example: This getter has a side effect: it also updates the last access time.
exampleTrans: 这个读取方法有副作用：它还会更新最后访问时间。

name: off-by-one
example: The last item was missing because of an off-by-one error in the loop.
exampleTrans: 最后一项丢了，是因为循环里有一个差一错误。

name: unit test
example: Please add unit tests for the new pricing rules.
exampleTrans: 请为新的定价规则添加单元测试。

name: integration test
example: The integration tests run against a real database in a container.
exampleTrans: 集成测试运行在容器里的真实数据库上。

name: end-to-end
example: Our end-to-end tests simulate a user going through the whole checkout.
exampleTrans: 我们的端到端测试模拟用户走完整个结账流程。

name: test coverage
example: Test coverage for the billing module is still below fifty percent.
exampleTrans: 计费模块的测试覆盖率仍低于百分之五十。

name: mock
example: We mock the email service so tests don't send real messages.
exampleTrans: 我们模拟了邮件服务，这样测试不会发真实邮件。

name: QA
trans: n. 质量保证（测试团队）
example: QA found two blocking issues in the release candidate.
exampleTrans: 测试团队在候选版本中发现了两个阻塞问题。

name: sanity check
trans: n. 基本检查；合理性检查
example: Can you do a quick sanity check on these numbers before I send them?
exampleTrans: 发出去之前，你能快速核对一下这些数字吗？

name: smoke test
example: Run a smoke test right after deploying to make sure the site loads.
exampleTrans: 部署后立刻跑一下冒烟测试，确认网站能打开。

name: triage
trans: v. 分诊；分类处理（问题）
example: Let's triage the new bugs and decide which ones to fix this week.
exampleTrans: 我们把新 bug 分一下类，决定本周修哪些。

name: severity
example: We marked the data loss issue as the highest severity.
exampleTrans: 我们把数据丢失问题标为最高严重级别。

name: code smell
example: A function with ten parameters is usually a code smell.
exampleTrans: 一个函数有十个参数通常就是代码坏味道。

name: validation
example: Input validation should happen on the server, not only in the browser.
exampleTrans: 输入校验应该在服务端做，而不仅仅在浏览器里做。

name: validate
example: Validate the email format before saving the user record.
exampleTrans: 保存用户记录前先校验邮箱格式。

name: sanitize
example: Always sanitize user input before rendering it on the page.
exampleTrans: 在页面上渲染用户输入前一定要先做过滤。

name: benchmark
example: Let's benchmark both approaches before deciding which one to use.
exampleTrans: 决定用哪个方案之前，我们先对两种方法做基准测试。

name: optimize
example: We optimized the image pipeline and cut page load time by a second.
exampleTrans: 我们优化了图片处理流程，页面加载时间缩短了一秒。

name: overhead
example: Logging every request adds noticeable overhead in high-traffic services.
exampleTrans: 在高流量服务里，每个请求都记日志会带来明显开销。

name: deprecate
example: We plan to deprecate the old endpoint and remove it in six months.
exampleTrans: 我们计划弃用旧接口，并在六个月后移除。

name: deprecated
example: This method is deprecated, so please switch to the new one.
exampleTrans: 这个方法已弃用，请改用新方法。

name: idempotent
example: Make the payment endpoint idempotent so retries don't charge twice.
exampleTrans: 把支付接口做成幂等的，这样重试不会重复扣款。

name: robust
example: We need more robust error handling around the file upload.
exampleTrans: 文件上传这块需要更健壮的错误处理。

name: leverage
example: We can leverage the existing auth service instead of building a new one.
exampleTrans: 我们可以利用现有的认证服务，而不是新建一个。

name: mitigate
example: We added a cache to mitigate the impact of slow database queries.
exampleTrans: 我们加了缓存来缓解慢查询的影响。

name: streamline
example: This script will streamline the release process for the whole team.
exampleTrans: 这个脚本会简化整个团队的发布流程。

name: extensible
trans: adj. 可扩展的（易于扩展功能）
example: The plugin system makes the editor highly extensible.
exampleTrans: 插件系统让这个编辑器非常易于扩展。

name: reusable
example: Try to make this component reusable across different pages.
exampleTrans: 尽量让这个组件能在不同页面间复用。

name: modular
example: A modular design lets each team work on their part independently.
exampleTrans: 模块化设计让每个团队能独立开发自己的部分。

name: maintainability
example: Splitting this huge file into smaller modules would really help maintainability.
exampleTrans: 把这个巨大的文件拆成更小的模块会大大提高可维护性。

name: readability
example: I renamed a few variables to improve readability.
exampleTrans: 我改了几个变量名来提高可读性。

name: redundant
example: This null check is redundant because the value is validated earlier.
exampleTrans: 这个空值检查是多余的，因为前面已经校验过了。

name: verbose
trans: adj. 冗长的；详细的（输出）
example: Run the command in verbose mode to see more details.
exampleTrans: 用详细模式运行这个命令，可以看到更多信息。

name: explicit
example: I prefer explicit type annotations on public functions.
exampleTrans: 我更喜欢在公开函数上写显式的类型注解。

name: implicit
example: The implicit conversion from string to number caused this bug.
exampleTrans: 这个 bug 是由字符串到数字的隐式转换导致的。

name: deterministic
example: Tests should be deterministic and give the same result every time.
exampleTrans: 测试应该是确定性的，每次结果都一样。

name: immutable
example: Keeping the state immutable makes bugs much easier to track down.
exampleTrans: 保持状态不可变能让 bug 更容易定位。

name: compatibility
example: We tested compatibility with the three most recent browser versions.
exampleTrans: 我们测试了与最近三个浏览器版本的兼容性。

name: lightweight
example: We picked a lightweight library to keep the bundle size small.
exampleTrans: 我们选了一个轻量级的库来控制打包体积。

name: straightforward
example: The fix is straightforward; we just need to update the regex.
exampleTrans: 修复很简单，只要更新一下正则就行。

name: non-trivial
trans: adj. 不简单的；有一定难度的
example: Migrating the old data is non-trivial, so let's plan extra time.
exampleTrans: 迁移旧数据不简单，我们多预留些时间。

name: caveat
trans: n. 注意事项；限制条件
example: One caveat: this approach doesn't work with older Android devices.
exampleTrans: 有一点要注意：这个方法在旧的安卓设备上不管用。

name: rationale
example: Please explain the rationale behind this design in the PR description.
exampleTrans: 请在 PR 描述中说明这个设计背后的理由。

name: constraint
example: Given our time constraints, let's go with the simpler solution.
exampleTrans: 考虑到时间限制，我们选更简单的方案吧。

name: assumption
example: The code makes the assumption that every user has an email.
exampleTrans: 这段代码假设每个用户都有邮箱。

name: feasible
example: Is it feasible to finish the migration before the holiday freeze?
exampleTrans: 在节前代码冻结之前完成迁移可行吗？

name: overkill
trans: n. 大材小用；过度设计
example: Adding Kubernetes for a single small service feels like overkill.
exampleTrans: 为一个小服务上 Kubernetes 感觉有点杀鸡用牛刀。

name: tweak
example: I tweaked the timeout settings and the errors went away.
exampleTrans: 我微调了超时设置，错误就消失了。

name: best practice
example: It's a best practice to never log passwords or tokens.
exampleTrans: 永远不要在日志中记录密码或令牌，这是最佳实践。

name: convention
example: Follow the existing naming convention used in the rest of the codebase.
exampleTrans: 遵循代码库中其他地方已有的命名约定。

name: under the hood
trans: phr. 在底层；内部实现上
example: Under the hood, the library just calls the REST API.
exampleTrans: 在底层，这个库其实只是调用了 REST API。

name: source of truth
example: The database should be the single source of truth for user settings.
exampleTrans: 数据库应该是用户设置的唯一可信数据源。

name: expose
example: We shouldn't expose internal IDs in the public API.
exampleTrans: 我们不应该在公开 API 中暴露内部 ID。

name: invoke
example: The handler is invoked every time a new message arrives.
exampleTrans: 每当有新消息到达，这个处理函数就会被调用。

name: override
example: You can override the default timeout with an environment variable.
exampleTrans: 你可以用环境变量覆盖默认超时时间。

name: propagate
example: Let the error propagate up so the caller can decide how to handle it.
exampleTrans: 让错误向上传递，由调用方决定如何处理。

name: parse
example: We parse the CSV file and convert each row into an order.
exampleTrans: 我们解析 CSV 文件，把每一行转换成一个订单。

name: trigger
example: Merging to main automatically triggers a deploy to staging.
exampleTrans: 合并到主分支会自动触发部署到预发布环境。

name: iterate
example: Let's ship a simple version first and iterate based on user feedback.
exampleTrans: 我们先发布一个简单版本，再根据用户反馈迭代。

name: clean up
example: I'll clean up the unused imports before merging.
exampleTrans: 合并前我会清理掉没用的导入。

name: real-time
example: We use WebSockets to push real-time updates to the dashboard.
exampleTrans: 我们用 WebSocket 向仪表盘推送实时更新。

name: canary release
trans: n. 金丝雀发布；灰度发布
example: We'll start with a canary release to catch problems before everyone gets it.
exampleTrans: 我们先做灰度发布，在全量之前发现问题。

name: dogfooding
trans: n. 内部试用（自用自家产品）
example: We've been dogfooding the new editor internally for two weeks.
exampleTrans: 我们已经在内部试用新编辑器两周了。

name: pair programming
example: Pair programming helped us isolate the concurrency bug before lunch.
exampleTrans: 结对编程帮助我们在午饭前定位了并发缺陷。

name: rubber ducking
example: Rubber ducking exposed a faulty assumption in my parsing logic.
exampleTrans: 橡皮鸭调试法暴露了我解析逻辑中的错误假设。

name: merge request
example: Please attach the benchmark results to your merge request.
exampleTrans: 请把基准测试结果附到你的合并请求中。

name: commit message
example: The commit message should explain why this workaround is necessary.
exampleTrans: 提交信息应说明为什么这个临时方案是必要的。

name: code owner
example: A code owner must approve changes to the payment module.
exampleTrans: 支付模块的改动必须由代码负责人批准。

name: merge queue
example: The merge queue reruns checks against the latest main branch.
exampleTrans: 合并队列会针对最新主分支重新运行检查。

name: squash
example: Squash the cleanup commits before you merge this branch.
exampleTrans: 合并这个分支前，请压缩那些清理性质的提交。

name: fast-forward
example: A fast-forward keeps the branch history linear and easy to inspect.
exampleTrans: 快进合并让分支历史保持线性且易于检查。

name: merge base
example: Find the merge base before comparing changes across release branches.
exampleTrans: 比较发布分支的改动前，先找到合并基点。

name: design pattern
example: This design pattern separates object creation from business logic.
exampleTrans: 这个设计模式把对象创建与业务逻辑分离。

name: anti-pattern
example: The review identified shared mutable state as an anti-pattern.
exampleTrans: 评审认定共享可变状态是一种反模式。

name: separation of concerns
example: Separation of concerns makes the service easier to test independently.
exampleTrans: 关注点分离让这个服务更容易独立测试。

name: single responsibility
example: Single responsibility keeps this class focused on invoice validation.
exampleTrans: 单一职责让这个类专注于发票校验。

name: inversion of control
example: Inversion of control lets the framework manage service lifecycles.
exampleTrans: 控制反转让框架管理服务的生命周期。

name: event-driven
example: Our event-driven architecture decouples checkout from email delivery.
exampleTrans: 我们的事件驱动架构将结账与邮件发送解耦。

name: eventual consistency
example: Eventual consistency is acceptable for the analytics counter.
exampleTrans: 分析计数器可以接受最终一致性。

name: strong consistency
example: Account balances require strong consistency across every replica.
exampleTrans: 账户余额要求所有副本之间保持强一致性。

name: circuit breaker
example: The circuit breaker prevents repeated calls to the failing provider.
exampleTrans: 熔断器会阻止反复调用发生故障的供应方。

name: backpressure
example: Backpressure stops slow consumers from exhausting queue memory.
exampleTrans: 背压可防止慢速消费者耗尽队列内存。

name: service discovery
example: Service discovery routes requests to healthy application instances.
exampleTrans: 服务发现会把请求路由到健康的应用实例。

name: health check
example: The health check fails when the database becomes unreachable.
exampleTrans: 数据库无法连接时，健康检查会失败。

name: graceful shutdown
example: Graceful shutdown allows active requests to finish before termination.
exampleTrans: 优雅停机允许活动请求在终止前完成。

name: connection pool
example: The connection pool reached its limit during the traffic spike.
exampleTrans: 流量激增期间，连接池达到了上限。

name: database shard
example: Each database shard stores customers from one geographic region.
exampleTrans: 每个数据库分片存储一个地理区域的客户数据。

name: read replica
example: A read replica handles reporting queries without slowing writes.
exampleTrans: 只读副本负责报表查询，避免拖慢写入。

name: cache invalidation
example: Cache invalidation runs whenever an article is updated.
exampleTrans: 每当文章更新时都会执行缓存失效。

name: cold start
example: The cold start adds noticeable latency to the first request.
exampleTrans: 冷启动给第一次请求增加了明显延迟。

name: memory footprint
example: The new parser reduces our memory footprint during large imports.
exampleTrans: 新解析器降低了大批量导入时的内存占用。

name: garbage collection
example: Garbage collection pauses explain the recurring latency spikes.
exampleTrans: 垃圾回收暂停解释了反复出现的延迟尖峰。

name: thread-safe
example: The shared client must remain thread-safe under parallel workloads.
exampleTrans: 共享客户端在并行负载下必须保持线程安全。

name: null pointer
example: A null pointer caused the worker to crash overnight.
exampleTrans: 一个空指针导致工作进程夜间崩溃。

name: type safety
example: Type safety catches invalid state transitions during compilation.
exampleTrans: 类型安全能在编译时发现无效的状态转换。

name: static typing
example: Static typing makes large refactors safer for this codebase.
exampleTrans: 静态类型让这个代码库的大规模重构更安全。

name: dynamic typing
example: Dynamic typing speeds prototyping but requires disciplined runtime validation.
exampleTrans: 动态类型加快原型开发，但需要严格的运行时校验。

name: contract testing
example: Contract testing caught an incompatible response before deployment.
exampleTrans: 契约测试在部署前发现了不兼容的响应。

name: property-based testing
example: Property-based testing revealed inputs our examples never covered.
exampleTrans: 基于属性的测试发现了示例从未覆盖的输入。

name: test harness
example: The test harness creates isolated databases for every suite.
exampleTrans: 测试工具框架为每个测试套件创建隔离数据库。

name: build artifact
example: The build artifact is signed before entering the release pipeline.
exampleTrans: 构建产物进入发布流水线前会被签名。

name: deployment window
